$Comment: Gunter summoned by the Ice King: hostile, unlike the neutral AT_Gunter. Variant of vanilla Template_Predator built like the vanilla Fox (bite attack and InteractionVars); attack: Root_AT_Gunter_Attack alternates AT_Gunter_Attack_1/_2 (the fox Fox_Bite hit with the custom Attack / Attack2 animations, set AT_Gunter); damage from the Bite_Damage var below. 2026-10-21 (playtest: flank me, don't all come from the same angle): combat movement of vanilla Wolf_Black (also a Template_Predator Variant without CAE): CombatDirectWeight 0 (never charge straight in, was 5), CombatStrafeWeight 10 (was 5: circle left/right around the player), CombatBackOffAfterAttack true with CombatBackOffDistanceRange [3, 5] (step back after a bite; max must stay under CombatBehaviorDistance), CombatBehaviorDistance 6 (was 5), CombatMovingRelativeSpeed 0.6 (slower while circling, was 0.8). 2026-10-21 (playtest: mostly wing slaps): Root_AT_Gunter_Attack walks a 14-step order of Slap/Slap2/headbutt (AT_Gunter_Attack_2)/belly lunge (AT_Gunter_Attack_1), each with its own hit (AT_Gunter_Slap/Belly/Headbutt_Damage: 5/9/13), so the Bite_Damage var below is no longer used by his attacks (kept for anything inheriting Fox_Bite). Not CombatTurns: it only works inside one flock, and summoned Gunters have none (joining the king's flock would make the king's ray hold fire when a Gunter is in the line). 2026-10-21 (Gunter bowling): AdditionalCombatBehaviorMacroElement = Component_AT_Gunter_Slide, a belly slide at the player picked now and then among his combat movements (3-6 blocks away). 2026-10-22 (playtest: defend the king like a pack): FlockArray set, which turns on Template_Predator's 'Flock_Attack' listener while Idle/asleep: the king's beacon (payload = whoever hit him) makes them lock that attacker and fight (LockedTarget, Combat.Maybe). Side effect, also wanted: henchmen flock together, and when one engages the rest join (vanilla pack behaviour). Already fighting someone, they keep their target. 2026-10-22, reverted the same day: with FlockArray set they stopped attacking the player while he hit the king. Template_Predator's flock logic made the members follow and target their flock leader, and the king's Flock_Attack beacon sent them to the random Combat.Maybe check (ChanceToBeAlertedWhenFlockAlerted 70) on every hit, back to Idle, where the target is cleared. FlockArray removed; they detect players on their own as before. The king's beacon stays harmless (nobody listens to it now). 2026-10-22 (playtest: sometimes the king hits the Gunters first and they hit him back, that must never happen): DisableDamageGroups [Self, AT_Ice_King_Group]. The victim's list makes vanilla cancel damage from those groups (NPCDamageSystems.FilterDamageSystem -> CombatSupport.getCanCauseDamage) unless the attacker's running Attack has DamageFriendlies (the king's do, so his ultimate still hurts them), and the Damage sensor that locks the attacker (Template_Predator, Friendly false) skips attackers in those groups (SensorDamage), so a henchman never targets the king for a hit. Their own attacks also hold fire with the king in the line (ActionAttack AvoidFriendlyFire).
